authorization_context: Human explicitly authorized defining the previously unspecified intraday semantics after the ambiguity was surfaced and before discovery/validation outcome access.

semantics.bar_clock: physical MT5 M5 bars; America/Sao_Paulo session-date mapping; exact expiry contracts only
semantics.synchronization: inner join WIN and WDO on identical physical M5 timestamps for the selected contracts; no interpolation
semantics.bar_return: log close-to-close on consecutive synchronized physical M5 bars only; no synthetic return across contract rolls, session gaps, or missing bars
semantics.next_bar_WIN: forward WIN log return over one synchronized M5 bar
semantics.next_bar_WDO: forward WDO log return over one synchronized M5 bar
semantics.next_session_WIN: forward WIN session-close log return over one physical synchronized session
semantics.next_session_WDO: forward WDO session-close log return over one physical synchronized session
semantics.lead_lag: integer steps in the native clock of the selected horizon; negative means dependence feature precedes target, zero contemporaneous feature-to-forward-target alignment, positive means target clock precedes feature; all shifts causal and rows lacking required history are dropped
semantics.rolling_windows: 20 or 60 observations in the native clock of the selected horizon
semantics.Pearson: rolling Pearson correlation between aligned WIN and WDO returns
semantics.Spearman: rolling Spearman rank correlation between aligned WIN and WDO returns
semantics.sign_concordance: rolling mean of +1 for equal nonzero return signs and -1 for opposite signs; zero-return pairs dropped
semantics.tail_quadrant_frequency: rolling signed frequency of joint same-tail minus opposite-tail observations, with tails defined ex ante by the 20th/80th empirical quantiles estimated using only observations strictly prior to the scored observation within the same discovery-side causal history
semantics.standardization: candidate score is the discovery-only mean metric divided by its discovery-only sample standard deviation; noncomputable/zero-variance candidates are ineligible
semantics.partition_boundary: features/targets scored in discovery may use only causal history from discovery; no validation or holdout rows may be read, joined, ranked, standardized, or used for thresholds before candidate freeze
